events.headline: Iran war talks stall: Rubio demands Iranian UN delegation leave the US after ceasefire-proposal talks break down; Trump tells TIME military action against Iran could resume after the midterms; Pentagon announces major overhaul including 20% cut to admirals/generals

Oil fell ~1-1.4% (Brent $96.92, WTI $89.18) as Gulf crude exports recover toward pre-war levels and US-Iran diplomacy advances, though fuel (vs. crude) supply remains tight and OPEC+ is expected to hold November quotas steady with output still ~5M bpd below pre-war levels
China's refiners have halted fuel exports until further notice, a move that could further tighten the global fuel market even as crude supply eases

China's suspension of its Oct-2025 rare-earth/lithium-battery/critical-minerals export controls remains in effect but is set to expire Nov 10, 2026; China separately added US rare-earth firms MP Materials and USA Rare Earth to its export-control list, keeping supply-chain risk elevated

Intel shares rose ~3.7% as Micron's strong fiscal Q4 results boosted AI-chip and memory sector sentiment; Synopsys and Amazon signed a $1B+ deal to speed custom chip development; AMD EPYC server-CPU orders extend into 2028

Fed Chair Warsh remains hawkish on inflation, and CME FedWatch-implied odds of an October rate hike rose to 49% (from 40%); Fed's September dot plot showed 16 of 18 officials projecting at least one more hike this year after the Sept 16 hike to 3.75-4.00%
